minutes.headline: Select Board heard residents oppose Rob's Hill logging, took no vote, and asked staff to research license fees.
minutes.summary: Most of the meeting was public comment on the Conservation Commission's Rob's Hill forestry cutting plan, which the Commission has paused for at least a year. The board then discussed a review of licensing and permit fees, its three goals, and the special Town Meeting warrant. Only a toll booth fundraiser approval and adjournment were moved as votes.

what_happened.line: The Select Board heard extended public comment, mostly opposing the Conservation Commission's Rob's Hill forestry cutting plan, and took no vote on it.
The board asked staff to gather more license fee data and comparable towns, to return at one of the first meetings in November, with no action now.
The board approved the Boys and Girls Club toll booth drive for Saturday, November 3rd, with a rain date of November 10th.
A motion to make the board's recommendation on all special Town Meeting warrant articles was withdrawn.
The Agricultural Commission appointment was tabled until the commission votes on its recommendation.

why_it_matters: Rob's Hill is town conservation land, and the cutting plan sits with the Conservation Commission, not the Select Board, so residents' objections here did not produce a board decision.
Changes to restaurant and alcohol license fees, including small yearly increases, would fall on local businesses and could shift how much of town costs are covered by fees rather than taxes.
The board has not yet taken a position on the special Town Meeting warrant articles, which residents will be asked to vote on.
watch_next: Staff return with license fee data and comparable towns at one of the first meetings in November.
Select Board and School Committee meet on November 7th; no board meeting on October 23rd.
